title: 雄猫道具与商店线（道具说明）（第 3／4 部分）

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [LOOKS LIKE YOU FINALLY GOT YOUR COSMOSUIT BACK ON]
rows.current: Tomcat: [都过了这么久了，看来你总算又穿上宇宙服了！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [AFTER ALL THIS TIME!]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [THAT'S THE DANGER OF TAKING THE THING OFF...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [把这东西脱下来就是这风险……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [AND ONCE YOU PAIR UP THE SUIT WITH THE COSMO HELM]
rows.current: Tomcat: [再把这套衣服配上宇宙头盔，你就能在任何大气环境里呼吸了！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [YOU'LL BE ABLE TO BREATHE IN ANY SORT OF ATMOSPHERE!]
[HEY, TOMCAT. I JUST PICKED UP SOME SORT OF WEIRD...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [嘿，雄猫。我刚捡到个奇怪的……]

rows.source: [...CARD THING?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [……卡片之类的？]

rows.source: [NOT JUST ANY CARD, THAT'S A COSMOCARD, PUP!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [可不是普通卡，那是宇宙卡，小狗！]

rows.source: [THEY'LL LET YOU LEARN A BIT MORE ABOUT CREATURES]
rows.current: Tomcat: [它们能让你更了解这些生物，]

rows.source: [WHILE ALSO LETTING YOU KNOW IF THEY DROP ANY LOOT!
rows.current: Tomcat: [也能告诉你它们会不会掉落战利品！

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [FINALLY GOT YOUR HELMET BACK! AFTER ALL THIS TIME!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [终于把头盔拿回来了！过了这么久！]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [I KNOW, RIGHT?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [可不是嘛？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [COMPLETE THAT WITH THE COSMO SUIT PORTION]
rows.current: Tomcat: [再配上宇宙服的衣身部分，就有一整套严丝合缝的气密制服啦！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [AND YOU'LL HAVE A NICE AIRTIGHT UNIFORM COMPLETE!]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THAT'LL LET YOU BREATHE IN ANY SORT OF ATMOSPHERE!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [能让你在任何大气环境里呼吸！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [AWWW, IS THAT A LEASH THAT YOU JUST PICKED UP THERE?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [哎呀，你刚捡到的是牵引绳吗？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [I DIDN'T KNOW YOU STILL NEEDED ONE OF THOSE!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [我不知道你还需要这个！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [HEY, A LITTLE PUPPY PLAY NEVER HURT ANYONE, RIGHT?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [嘿，偶尔玩玩小狗扮演，又没什么坏处，对吧？]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [NOTHING BAD ABOUT PRETENDING TO BE A LIL PUP AGAIN.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [再假装一回小狗，也没什么不好嘛。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WOW, SHAMELESS AREN'TYA GIRL? YOU'D NEVER CATCH ME DO-]
rows.current: Tomcat: [哇，不害臊是吧，姑娘？你绝对见不到我去-]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [YOU'RE GONNA TELL ME YOU STILL DON'T DIP INTO SOFT FOOD]
rows.current: Yiffany: [你该不会告诉我，你现在还是不偶尔吃点软食吧？]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [EVERY NOW AND AGAIN?]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [HEY, L-LOOK, THAT'S... THAT'S COMPLETELY...]
rows.current: Tomcat: [嘿，听、听着，那是……那完全是……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [I'VE GOT R-R-REPORTS TO DO, B-BYE!!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [我还有报、报告要做，再、再见！！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [HEE!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [嘿！]

rows.source: [NOW THAT'S A PRETTY STYLISH COLLAR YOU GOT THERE. SOLID!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [你这项圈还真时髦。够结实！]

rows.source: [I'M ONLY WEARING IT BECAUSE I HAVE NO CHOICE, OKAY??]
rows.current: Yiffai: [我只是没得选才戴着的，懂吗？？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [OKAY I KNOW THAT THE SELLER TOLD YOU THAT IT WAS MEAT]
rows.current: Tomcat: [好吧，我知道卖家告诉你那是肉，可我在那包里没检测到任何蛋白质……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [BUT I'M NOT DETECT- ING ANYTHING PROTEIN IN THAT PACKAGE...]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [IT SMELLS KIND OF LIKE...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [闻起来有点像……]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [...GASOLINE?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [……汽油？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [BLECH! WELL, ENJOY THAT. I'M GONNA GO THROW UP NOW.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [呕！好吧，你享用那个吧。我现在要去吐了。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [THAAAAAANKS...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [谢啊啊啊啊啊啊……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [PSH, IS THAT AN ICE SODA YOU'VE GOT?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [切，你拿的是冰汽水吗？]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [YEAH! THE SHOPKEEPER SAID IT WAS]
rows.current: Yiffai: [对！店主说它是这星球上最酷的饮料！]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [THE COOLEST DRINK ON THE PLANET!]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [NEVER KNOW WHAT YOU'LL RUN INTO OUT THERE.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [在外面永远不知道会碰上什么。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [IT KINDA MAKES ME MISS FIELD WORK, A BIT...]
rows.current: Tomcat: [这有点让我想念外勤，有一点……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [OH THAT'S A SPECIAL THING YOU JUST PICKED UP! A KEY!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [噢，你捡到个特别的东西！钥匙！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THEY CAN FIT IN MANY DIFFERENT STYLES OF LOCKS AND]
rows.current: Tomcat: [它们能开好多种锁，而且我们知道，有些特工就被锁在门后！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WE KNOW SOME AGENTS ARE LOCKED BEHIND SOME OF THEM!]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [IS THAT WHY THE MISSION BRIEF SAID THAT US AGENTS]
rows.current: Yiffai: [所以任务简报才说，我们特工任何时候都不能丢掉它们？]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [WEREN'T ALLOWED TO DISCARD THEM, AT ANY TIME?]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [YEAH, THAT'S WHY EVERY AGENT WAS SUPPLIED WITH]
rows.current: Tomcat: [对，所以每个特工才都配了一整套……随身……包……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [A FULL SET OF... CARRYING... BAGS...]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.current: Yiffai: [……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [...WELL GOOD LUCK!! BYE!!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [……那就祝你好运！！拜拜！！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [WOW, COME IN TOMCAT. YOU'RE NOT GONNA BELIEVE THIS.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [哇，雄猫请回答。你不会相信的。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [SIGH...]
rows.current: Tomcat: [叹气……]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [YOU HAVE ANY IDEA WHAT I JUST PICKED UP?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [你知道我刚捡到什么吗？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.current: Tomcat: [……]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [LOOK! ONE OF THOSE SCALE SUIT BODIES! LIKE WHEN WE WERE]
rows.current: Yiffany: [看！是那种鳞片套装的衣身！跟学院那会儿，你参加的那个性社团用的一样！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [IN THE ACADEMY AND YOU WERE PART OF THAT SEX CLUB!]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [DO YOU HAVE TO BRING THIS UP ON COMPANY TIME?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [你非得在上班时间提这个吗？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [FIRST OF ALL, IT WASN'T A SEXUAL THING.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [首先，那不是性方面的事。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [MAAAYBE I FOOLED AROUND WITH ONE ON, SURE, WHATEVER.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [也——许我穿着一套胡闹过，当然，随便吧。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [BUT THAT WAS JUST KIND OF A JOKE AND IT WAS MOSTLY ABOUT]
rows.current: Tomcat: [不过就是闹着玩，主要图个开心、放松一下罢了。拜托。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [HAVING FUN AND LET- TING LOOSE, THAT'S ALL. COME ON.]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [LOOSE IS RIGHT. I REMEMBER THE SIZE OF SOME OF THOSE TOYS.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [是够松的。我可记得有些玩具的尺寸。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [S I G H]
rows.current: Tomcat: [叹 气]

rows.source: [NOT SURE WHO WOULD LEAVE AROUND SOMETHING LIKE THAT]
rows.current: Tomcat: [不知道谁会把那种东西随手丢着，]

rows.source: [CONSIDERING THAT SCALE SUITS CAN COST THOUSANDS OF LECT]
rows.current: Tomcat: [毕竟一套鳞装可能要花上几千Lect，]

rows.source: [BUT IF YOU'RE COMFORTABLE PUTTING IT ON, GO FOR IT!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [不过你要是穿着舒服，那就穿吧！]

rows.source: [LOOK I'M NOT ONE TO COMMENT ON THIS SORTA STUFF, BUT...]
rows.current: Tomcat: [听着，我一般不评论这种东西，不过……]

rows.source: [JUST... MAKE SURE YOU GET A FULL SET OF KOBO GEAR]
rows.current: Tomcat: [只是……务必凑齐一整套科博德装备，也就是爪子、头部和身体……]

rows.source: [WHICH MEANS THE CLAWS, HEAD, AND BODY...]
[...OR I'M GONNA HAVE TO JUDGE YA FOR WEARING A PARTIAL]
rows.current: Tomcat: [……不然我可要笑话你只穿半套]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THAT'S A MAP DISK THAT YOU JUST PICKED UP THERE!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [你刚捡到的是地图磁盘！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [OTHER AGENTS HAVE MAPPED OUT VARIOUS PARTS OF THE AREA]
rows.current: Tomcat: [其他特工绘制了你当前所在区域各部分的地图，有时还带标注。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THAT YOU'RE CURR- ENTLY IN, SOMETIMES WITH NOTATION.]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [JUST NAVIGATE OVER TO THE APPROPRIATE P.A.W. SUBMENU]
rows.current: Tomcat: [只要进到对应的 P.A.W. 子菜单，就能看到新内容！]

rows.source: [TO SEE WHAT'S NEW!]
[NOW THIS HAT REALLY MAKES A STATEMENT, DON'T YOU THINK?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [这顶帽子一戴，气势就出来了，是不是？]

rows.source: [YAR HAR! A PIRATE'S LIFE AMONG THE STARS!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [呀哈！星海间的海盗生涯！]

rows.source: [GIVE ME YER VALUABLES, QUICKLIKE!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [快把你值钱的东西交出来！]

rows.source: [OKAY YOU'RE GETTING MORE INTO THIS THAN ME, NEVERMIND...]
rows.current: Yiffany: [好吧，你比我还入戏，算了……]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [AWWW LOOK AT THIS ADORABLE LITTLE JUICE BOX!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [哎呀，看这可爱的小果汁盒！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [I HAVEN'T HAD THESE SINCE I WAS A PUPPY!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [我从幼犬时期就没喝过这些了！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [DID YOU EVER ACTUALLY DRINK ONE OF THOSE?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [你真的喝过这种吗？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [REMEMBER, YOU USED TO ALWAYS TRADE THEM OFF FOR MEAT.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [记得吧，你以前总拿它们去换肉。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [UNTIL YOU GOT OLDER AND LEARNED THAT IT WAS EASIER TO TRAD-]
rows.current: Tomcat: [后来长大了，才发现还有更省事的换——]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [-TRADE MONEY FOR MORE MEAT AT THE STORE, YUP!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [——用钱去店里换更多肉，没错！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [O RLY]
rows.current: Tomcat: [哦是吗]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [TOTALLY! JUST A SHAME I WAS TOO BUSY FUCKING CLASSMATES]
rows.current: Yiffany: [当然！只可惜我忙着操同学，没怎么去成店里，哈哈！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [TO GET DOWN TO THE STORE MUCH HAHA!]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [H-HAHA... YOU'RE TALKING ABOUT COLLEGE NOW, RIGHT?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [哈、哈哈……你现在说的是大学吧？]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [SORRY CAN'T HEAR YOU. TOO BUSY JUICING!!!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [抱歉听不见。忙着榨汁呢！！！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [SLRRRP]
rows.current: Yiffany: [吸溜]

rows.source: [AWWW LOOK AT THIS ADORABLE LITTLE JUICE BOX!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [哎呀，看这可爱的小果汁盒！]

rows.source: [I HAVEN'T HAD THESE SINCE I WAS A PUPPY!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [我从幼犬时期就没喝过这些了！]

rows.source: [DID YOU EVER ACTUALLY DRINK ONE OF THOSE?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [你真的喝过这种吗？]

rows.source: [REMEMBER, YOU USED TO ALWAYS TRADE THEM OFF FOR SNACKS.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [记得吗，你以前总拿它们去换零食。]

rows.source: [OF COURSE! I DRANK THE FIRST ONE I EVER GOT!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [当然！我第一次拿到手就喝掉了！]

rows.source: [THAT'S HOW I LEARNED THAT IT WAS BETTER TO TRADE EM]
rows.current: Yiffany: [就是那次让我明白，还是拿去换东西比较好。]

rows.source: [I GUESS THAT MAKES SENSE...]
rows.current: Tomcat: [听起来也有道理……]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [SO, I JUST GOT THIS SHIP PART...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [那么，我刚拿到了这个船件……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [I SAW! HEAVY EQUIPMENT ISN'T MY SPECIALTY, BUT]
rows.current: Tomcat: [我看到了！重型设备不是我的专长，但是我们在旧机库请了一位当地机械师，他可以给你进一步的建议。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WE'VE CONTRACTED A LOCAL MECHANIC AT THE OLD HANGAR WHO]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [CAN ADVISE YOU FURTHER.]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [GOT IT. I'LL ASK THE MECHANIC.]
rows.current: Yiffai: [明白了。我会去问那位机械师。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [I'VE SECURED A REPLACEMENT PART FOR MY SHIP.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [我搞到了飞船的替换零件。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [I SAW! HEAVY EQUIPMENT ISN'T MY SPECIALTY, BUT]
rows.current: Tomcat: [我看到了！重型装备不是我的专长，不过我们在旧机库雇了个本地机械师，可以给你进一步的建议。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WE'VE CONTRACTED A LOCAL MECHANIC AT THE OLD HANGAR WHO]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [CAN ADVISE YOU FURTHER.]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [ALRIGHT, I'LL TAKE IT BACK TO HIM.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [好，我拿回去给他。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WELL WELL, LOOKS LIKE YOU GOT YOURSELF AN]
rows.current: Tomcat: [哟哟，看来你搞到了一只反重力踝环！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [ANTI-GRAV ANKLET!]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [YEAH, NEVER DID LIKE THESE THINGS. PREFER MY TAZER]
rows.current: Yiffany: [是啊，我一直不喜欢这东西。我更喜欢双脚着地，用电击枪进行对决。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [DUELS WITH BOTH FEET ON THE GROUND.]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [NOT TO MENTION, YOU COULD NEVER BEAT MY AIRTIME RECORD]
rows.current: Tomcat: [更何况，你当年在学院可从没破过我的滞空纪录……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [BACK AT THE ACADEMY...]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [GRR. NOT LIKE I TRIED VERY HARD OR ANYTHING...]
rows.current: Yiffany: [哼，又不是我认真试过了……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [RIIIGHT. WELL YOU PROBABLY DON'T NEED TO HEAR IT, BUT]
rows.current: Tomcat: [是——啊。好吧，你大概不用听，不过半空中贴墙再跳，就能触发！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [HUG A WALL MID-AIR AND JUMP AGAIN TO TRIGGER IT!]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [I REMEMBER HOW TO USE IT!!! YIFFANY OUT!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [我记得怎么用！！！伊吠妮完毕！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [NEAT! YOU'VE GOT YOURSELF A BOOSTER BRACE THERE GRRRL.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [不错！你搞到一只助推护腕了，丫头。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THOSE ARE STANDARD ISSUE ON COSMO- BREEDER UNIFORMS]
rows.current: Tomcat: [那是宇宙育种者制服的标配，能让你随意冲刺！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [AND WILL LET YOU DASH AT WILL!]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [JUST A SHAME THE REST OF MY UNIFORM WASN'T WITH IT...]
rows.current: Yiffany: [只可惜我制服的其余部分没在一起……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [PFT, YEAH RIGHT. AND BE FORCED TO WEAR PANTS SO SOON?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [噗，得了吧。这么快就被迫穿裤子？]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [LOOK, I'VE GOTTA PRETEND THAT I'M UPSET ABOUT IT!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [听着，我得装出为此难过的样子！]

rows.source: [NEAT! YOU'VE GOT YOURSELF A BOOSTER BRACE THERE GRRRL.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [不错！你搞到一只助推护腕了，丫头。]

rows.source: [THOSE ARE STANDARD ISSUE ON COSMO- BREEDER UNIFORMS]
rows.current: Tomcat: [那是宇宙育种者制服的标配，能让你随意冲刺！]

rows.source: [AND WILL LET YOU DASH AT WILL!]
[YOU FOUND YOUR ID! THAT SHOULD HELP YOU ACCESS]
rows.current: Tomcat: [你找到证件了！这下应该能使用那些老式3P设备，比如点对点传送台。]

rows.source: [OLD 3P TECH LIKE THOSE SITE-TO-SITE TELEPADS.]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THAT'S *NOT* A STANDARD RADIO YOU'RE USING, GIRL!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [你用的*不是*标准无线电，姑娘！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [WHAT, CAN'T GET A GOOD LOCK ON ITS SIGNAL?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [怎么，锁不住它的信号？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [NO THE SIGNAL IS FINE AND ALL. AND IT LOOKS LIKE IT HAS]

rows.source: [YEAH. I GET THE FEELING THIS POWER WILL MAKE ME]
rows.current: Yiffany: [是啊。我感觉这股力量会让我更耐打，不过战斗能力会下降。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [TOUGHER, BUT REDUCE MY COMBAT EFFECTIVENESS.]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WITH NO DATA, WE'LL HAVE TO TRUST YOUR INSTINCTS.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [没有数据，我们就只能相信你的直觉了。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [BUT BE CAREFUL WITH THAT, GIRL.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [但要小心那东西，姑娘。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [YEAH. SEEMS LIKE A DOUBLE-EDGED SWORD. YIFFANY OUT.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [是啊。看来像把双刃剑。伊吠妮通话结束。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WOAH, I JUST SAW ANOTHER SPIKE IN YOUR VITALS!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [哇，我刚看到你的生命体征又出现一次飙升！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [YOU MESSING WITH ANOMALOUS 'POWERS' AGAIN, PUP?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [你又在摆弄那些异常的'力量'了，小狗？]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [HEY, THE ORB WAS JUST FLOATING RIGHT THERE!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [嘿，那球就正好悬浮在那儿呢！]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [IT SEEMS... THIS POWER MIGHT MAKE ME TOUGHER? BUT...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [看来……这股力量也许能让我更耐打？但是……]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [WITH A TRADEOFF, ATTACKING THREATS... HURTS THEM LESS?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [也有代价：打起敌人来……造成的伤害会变小？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [STARS HELP US, BUT I THINK YOU'RE THE EXPERT HERE.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [星辰保佑我们，但我觉得你才是这里的专家。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [JUST BE CAREFUL, KIDDO...]
rows.current: Tomcat: [小心点就是了，小家伙……]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [I'LL TRY TO BE. YIFFAI OUT.]
rows.current: Yiffai: [我会尽量小心的。伊吠通话结束。]
